text:
morgan: Quick async check — prefetched KV ownership drift showed up in last night's perf run, want to confirm owners and next milestones. p50 improved but p95 regressed ~7% on long sequences.

alex: saw the alert, thanks for flagging. which canary did you run?

morgan: ran the nightly perf job against canary-3 (kernel-opt + prefetch-heuristic v2). command:```./tools/run_perf --suite=kv_warmup --canary=canary-3 --seq=2048 --runs=20```

jia: ok, that is the canary with the new eviction heuristic, right? v2 trades off early prefetch for reduced memory churn.

morgan: yes. eviction = heuristic-v2 + adaptive-prefetch-window=3. results attached in the job but TL;DR: throughput steady, p95 token latency +7%, cold-hot variance up.

sam: do you have the job id? I can pull flamegraphs.

morgan: job id perf-20260318-43. link: https://perf.redwood/internal/jobs/perf-20260318-43

raja: quick ownership note — kernel team owns the eviction code, runtime team owns prefetch window and batching strategy. need a short sync to decide tradeoffs.

alex: flagged a TODO in the prefetch PR (RFC #412). @jia can you prioritize review? it blocks the canary rollback/forward decision.

jia: on it, will review today. expecting ~30m.

sam: I pulled the traces. big signal in kv_fetch() around step 6 -> spikes when prefetch overlaps heavy microbatching. looks like contention on the lock that manages the kv cache warmup.

morgan: interesting — could be that adaptive window triggers overlapping prefetches under high concurrency. that would raise p95.

raja: proposal: temporarily gate adaptive-prefetch-window behind a feature flag so we can test kernel-only optimizations vs prefetch-on. that lets us isolate impact.

alex: agree. suggest rollout plan: 1) gate -> canary, 2) kernel micro-optimizations (lock sharding) on separate canary, 3) A/B 24h. if stable, rollout.

morgan: sounds good. can we get PR links here?

jia: prefetch PR: https://code.redwood/prefetch/PR-889 (changes: adaptive window, small metric hooks).

raja: kernel lock sharding PR: https://code.redwood/kernel/PR-1324 (shards lock by kv-bucket).

sam: I added a small test to simulate concurrent prefetches:```python
# repro snippet
for t in range(0, 64):
  p.run(request(seq=2048, concurrency=8))
```
results show queue length growth when both changes active.

alex: action items: - @jia review PR-889 today - @raja coordinate kernel PR smoke tests - @sam produce flamegraphs and add to perf job - @morgan draft rollout gate flag and notify on-call

jia: review scheduled, will post comments inline. :thumbsup:

raja: running kernel smoke now, will report in ~45m.

deploy-bot: deploy started for canary-4 (prefetch gate ON) by raja — build bld-20260318-77.

morgan: thanks. can we also capture token-level breakdown? console query:```SELECT quantile(0.95, token_latency) FROM tokens WHERE canary='canary-4' AND model='redwood-small' GROUP BY hour```

sam: will add token breakdown to perf job outputs. planning to compare per-model and per-seq bucket.

alex: if PR-889 needs changes, call it out early. don't let the canary sit with unknown regressions.

jia: posted initial review comments — mostly nits but one potential race in the metric hook. I'll add a suggested patch.

raja: kernel smoke passed basic e2e, no obvious lock regression on my quick run. will push durability test next.

morgan: thanks everyone. I'll update the sprint board: milestone = "prefetch isolation + kernel sharding" target = 2026-03-21. owners: kernel=@raja, prefetch=@jia, perf=@sam, coord=@morgan.

sam: noted. I'll queue a 2h extended perf run once jia's patch lands.

alex: pinging infra to increase canary capacity for the 24h A/B @ops-team :eyes:

morgan: final note — if p95 still regresses after isolation, we may revert adaptive window and keep sharding. let's avoid rolling everything back together.

raja: agreed. posting results here when durability test finishes.

deploy-bot: canary-4 deployed successfully to us-west-2, health=ok, rollout=25%.

morgan: closing loop for now — I'll create a follow-up thread with consolidated perf graphs once sam uploads. thanks all. :raised_hands:
